The project's own terms (guidelines §6.6); the corpus ../renderings.md (§0–§9; §9 fixed for this run) binds first. Lemmas: ETCSL / ePSD2 citation forms. "Lines" = ETCSL labels. Hebrew as in the > lines (plene, niqqud only where the line has it). Re-checked against the drafted lines on 2026-10-22 by script (every Hebrew string of the "Check" column is found in the > line of every listed line).
